summary: Master advanced loyalty program design and customer retention strategies. Learn RFM analysis, CLV modeling, and AI-driven personalization to reduce churn.
lede: Customer loyalty training helps loyalty and CRM practitioners design retention programs around customer behavior and program economics. Participants learn to segment customers with RFM analysis, identify churn signals, and build tiered or points-based rewards. They also practice forecasting customer lifetime value, managing reward costs, and shaping personalized communications to support retention.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-to-advanced program is designed for practitioners who manage the complex intersection of customer data, marketing strategy, and financial performance.
modules: Economics of Retention and CLV Foundations
prerequisites: Participants should have 3+ years of experience in marketing, CRM, or customer service management. A basic understanding of data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) and familiarity with common marketing metrics like ROI and conversion rate is required.
